Create an ultra-realistic vertical cinematic portrait of a sophisticated young man with a powerful luxury-fashion presence. Aspect ratio 3:4, resolution 1152x1536.
Subject: Male, medium close-up portrait captured from a subtle low angle, standing confidently with shoulders slightly turned away from the camera and face returning toward the lens. Stoic, mysterious and self-assured expression, direct gaze through black oval futuristic sunglasses. Strong natural masculine facial structure, realistic pores, authentic skin texture, detailed beard strands and individual hair texture. Slicked-back dark textured hair and full dense well-groomed dark beard.
Wardrobe: Deep black premium oversized collared shirt, minimalist luxury styling, sophisticated monochrome appearance.
Background: Dramatic seamless studio environment with a deep crimson base transitioning into intense orange-red, subtle atmospheric glow concentrated behind the subject, creating a cinematic halo effect.

Lighting: Powerful cinematic studio lighting with a warm directional key light from slightly above and to the side, deep sculpted facial shadows, subtle orange-red rim lighting around the hair, jawline and shoulders, minimal fill, dramatic high contrast, mysterious premium mood.
Camera: Professional 85mm portrait lens, slightly low-angle perspective, shallow depth of field, razor-sharp focus on sunglasses, eyes area, beard and facial texture, smooth cinematic background separation, realistic lens rendering.
Composition: Upper-body portrait, subject centered with slightly elevated positioning, strong symmetrical visual balance, moderate headroom, clean uncluttered frame, face and sunglasses dominating the composition.
Color grading: Deep crimson, scarlet, orange-red and pure black. Rich cinematic blacks, warm controlled highlights, strong tonal separation, luxury editorial color grade.
Post-processing: Photorealistic skin with visible natural pores, detailed beard and hair, enhanced micro-contrast, crisp facial details, subtle realistic film grain, controlled cinematic HDR, wide dynamic range, premium fashion magazine finish.
